tools.name: find_places
tools.description: The places nearest a point, nearest first, with their distance, address, opening hours and the page each one is on. Ask for a category when the question names one: post-offices, parcel-lockers, drop-off-points, post-boxes, express-post-boxes or collection-points.

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Everything about one place from an earlier answer: address, opening hours, what it accepts, and when the record was last checked.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Suburbs and places matching a name, for turning 'Coburg' or 'Coburg Post Office' into somewhere with a coordinate and a page.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_places · Private data: get_place · Public sink: find_places, search_places · Destructive: find_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_places · Private data: get_place · Public sink: find_places, search_places · Destructive: find_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
